description: Agent Feedback: submit the feedback being relied on now about a specific piece of work: optionally the work with its current version and each version with when it was released and whether it is still in use; each piece of feedback with its id, the point as given, the version it is about, when it was given, its tone, how it is relied on now (as evidence of quality, as the basis for a change, as an open issue or other), the id of later feedback on the same point that supersedes it and a later change that already answers it; the moment it is relied on; and how many days old praise may be and still count as current evidence of quality (180 when left out). The signed report gives the work and its versions, every piece of feedback as current, version_gone, stale_praise, superseded, answered, earlier_version or unconfirmed with its age in days, and the oldest and newest ages, and names feedback that no longer describes the work: acting today on feedback about a version no longer in use, and old praise presented as current evidence of quality; then feedback superseded by later feedback on the same point, feedback a later change already answers, and feedback about an earlier version with no record of whether it still applies, with the fix for each. How an agent’s durable reputation score ages is wever_reputation-decay-check, drift in an evaluation’s results is wever_evaluation-drift-check, and whether an agent’s knowledge entries are current is wever_knowledge-freshness-check. Verdict feedback_stale, feedback_freshness_gaps, feedback_freshness_unverified or feedback_current. POST /api/feedback-freshness-check. Reads only the recorded feedback material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no feedback is sent, no party is contacted and no work is changed. Agent Feedback reads the working feedback loop on one piece of work between a giver and a receiver: it is not scoring or benchmarking (the wever_evaluation checks), not a durable standing record (the wever_reputation checks) and not how agents organize shared work (the wever_coordination checks). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-feedback-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-feedback/.

as_of.description: The moment the feedback is relied on, to read its age against.

feedback.description: Each piece of feedback being relied on now.

answered_by.description: A later change that already answers it, such as release 2.3.

id.description: The feedback id, such as f1.

relied_on_as.description: How it is relied on now: as evidence of quality, as the basis for a change, as an open issue or other.

superseded_by.description: The id of later feedback in this list on the same point.

tone.description: Praise, criticism, a suggestion, a question or mixed.

version.description: The version of the work the feedback is about.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

max_age_days.description: How many days old feedback may be and still count as current evidence of quality; 180 when left out.

current_version.description: The version of the work in use now.

name.description: The work the feedback is about.

retired.description: The version is no longer in use.

name: wever_feedback-freshness-check
title: Feedback freshness check
